title: fix(app-shell): publish-all seed warning says the pack sentence, not engine text
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6v19uPsX6gX42G8tGcvvzb)_
Fixes #35141

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:首页「全部发布」和草稿预览条的发布,在示例数据(seed)载入失败时,警告提示的详情行改为语言包里的那句「示例数据未能加载。」,不再显示 seed 载入器的英文内部报错,也不再显示写死的英文「NAME: sample data failed to load」。
- 为什么改:用中文发布的搭建者会在警告下看到英文的引擎文本;#32984 的裁决是面向用户的文字只用客户句、不用开发者文本,AI 对话里的发布健康行早已这样做,这个入口还没跟上。
- 风险与回滚:只改一个 hook 里警告详情取哪句话,不动接口、语言键和导出;回滚即 revert 本 PR。引擎文本从此不在该提示中出现(对话里的「技术细节」折叠仍保留它)。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts`(`seedFailed` 标志与 `seedWarn` 那一处 toast);`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/usePublishAllDrafts.seedWarn-35141.test.tsx`;`.changeset/35141-publish-all-seed-warn-pack-sentence.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/usePublishAllDrafts.seedWarn-35141.test.tsx`,预期 8 个用例全绿(en 与 zh-Hans 两种语言)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`usePublishAllDrafts` (Home's *Publish all* and the draft-preview bar) warns `home.pendingDrafts.seedWarn` when a seed fails. The warning's description used to be the first entry of a list filled from two sources that are not customer sentences:

- the package batch: `health.seedError` (the seed loader's engine text) ahead of the pack sentence;
- the package-less loop: `seedApplied.error` (engine text again), else a hard-coded English `NAME: sample data failed to load` in every locale.

The list is replaced by one `seedFailed` flag set from either door, and the description is always the pack sentence `chatbot.build.health.seedFailed`: the sentence the chat's `PublishHealthLine` says for the same failure (objectstack#32984 Q1 ruling: user-facing text is the customer sentence, never developer or engine text). `seedApplied` carries no customer sentence in the spec today, so there is no producer sentence to prefer. The package-less loop uses the plain pack sentence without the draft name, which is how the chat line and the batch door already word it; no locale key is added.

The changeset is `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`. No locale keys, props or exports change.

## Tests

New file `usePublishAllDrafts.seedWarn-35141.test.tsx` (its own file because `I18nProvider` installs a module-level i18next global, as the sibling `userMessage-34553` pin does), with the shipped `en` and `zh-Hans` packs:

- a package batch whose `seedApplied` failed with engine text: title is the pack's `seedWarn`, description is the pack's `seedFailed`, the engine text is absent;
- a package-less seed that failed with engine text: same;
- a package-less seed that failed with no text: description is the pack sentence, not the English fallback;
- CONTROL: a package-less seed that loaded raises no warning and one success toast.

<details><summary>Harness reading on the unfixed source (zh-Hans included) = ablation, then restore</summary>

The fix was committed first (3cf598ff98). The mutation leg restored `usePublishAllDrafts.ts` from the base commit 0188989212 (tree only); on-disk proof: the old engine-text push spelling counted 1, the new `let seedFailed = false` counted 0. The subject resolves through source (relative import), so no build sits between the edit and the run.

```
Received: "seed apply stopped at the seed for object 'crm_task': Reference not found: owner = "ann""

os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 1
```

The 6 failures are the six defect cases (3 per locale); the 2 passes are the CONTROL cases. Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- FILE`, then the file's hash equals the HEAD blob (76a3fe6ba1) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

</details>

All six `usePublishAllDrafts` pin files, including the existing objectstack#32984 case that asserts the pack key as the description.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Same family, outside this card's file fence: the AI chat page's publish door (`AiChatPage.tsx`, the `console.ai.seedWarn` toast in `onPublishDrafts`) also puts `seedApplied.error` (engine text) into the description, and with no `error` it puts `String(seedApplied.errors[0])`, which for a structured error row reads `[object Object]`. Reported to the seat for filing, not fixed here.
- The full app-shell suite and the wide UI run are left to CI (`Test UI`, `Type Check UI`); locally only the targeted pins, the app-shell type-check and the derived gate list ran.
